body:
Answer: Neither is universally better. Germany often wins on public tuition + Ausbildung options but needs funds/language planning. The UK is clearer for English degrees with CAS + maintenance rules but usually costs more. Choose by budget, language and career target.

Evidence standard before you spend

For anything related to germany, study, keep proofs that a third party can verify: offers on letterhead, bank PDFs with history, attestation receipts, and language results that match the program. Screenshots without context are not a file. If a seller asks you to hide a refusal, change the topic — that is not how SK Immigration works.

  • Offer/contract names match the passport spelling
  • Language rule is printed (IELTS score, MOI, German level, etc.)
  • Funds story matches 3–6 months of statements where missions care about history
  • Attestation order is destination-correct (Apostille vs MOFA paths are not toys)
  • Official mission or university pages were opened the same week you pay

Mistakes we see on “germany vs uk study” files

  • Treating “germany vs uk study” as a slogan instead of a document checklist
  • Transferring deposits before CUIN and written fee scope are confirmed
  • Copy-pasting another student’s SOP or bank story
  • Hiring anyone who sells a guaranteed visa outcome
